corpus.notes: Corpus is heavily saturated on the P1 performance band this run targeted: interim runs (#151-#235) already documented most of the DOM/layout/render/JS-bridge/scroll/cache/lock/growth surface. Verified the v0.0.19 Windows work (viewport cull in cerberus-text, GUI subsystem in main.rs) is already covered — the glyph-cull GlyphBox.h=0 straddle bug is #204, the console-subsystem CLI output loss is #208, mirror uncached relayout is #215/#22-comment. Confirmed several candidate perf-growth findings were already filed (DNS single-flight #184, HttpCache eviction #221, connection reuse #210, storage fsync-on-UI #217, image decode on UI #211, event-dispatch full readback #195, scroll display-list clone/rescan #207, glyph cache wholesale-clear #234, HintingInstance unbounded #205). ua_memo unbounded growth (net engine) noted but trivial-size, not filed. Farbling seed being per-head (not per-eTLD+1) is a documented design decision per README/threat model, not filed. Per-navigation state (images/forms/node_to_js) is correctly reset — no leak there.

findings.title: CSS var() substitution has no output/expansion cap — exponentially-branching custom properties (billion-laughs) hang or OOM the browser
collect_vars deep-clones the entire inherited custom-property map per declaring element — O(elements x vars) cascade allocation on var-heavy design systems
